set.body: Audit fixture is full rank with 24 participants and four predictors. Rescaling one predictor by 1e-6 while adjusting its contrast weight preserves the estimand; R QR retains rank 4 and coefficient agreement 3.33e-16 after back-transformation. Current GroupGlm OLS rejects the design as non-positive-definite; FE and DL return successful NaN maps. Root cause candidate: unscaled normal equations and a tolerance tied to the largest Gram diagonal. Owner: ScalaFIM scientific preparation, using stable public Gale factorization/scaling capabilities; generic solver improvements belong in Gale. Acceptance: scale, offset, column-order and weighted fixtures against independent QR/SVD; identifiable contrasts invariant; true rank deficiency remains explicit; JVM+JS. Evidence: audit bd-01M20MJY5QG8F7X2ZQENTTWPD7.
set.title: Group GLM: preserve estimands under covariate unit changes
